description:
self tapping scr 4.2x13 pan hd
What it is: A self-tapping screw, 4.2mm in diameter and 13mm long, with a pan head, made of steel, which is a finished product used for fastening materials together.
reason: The description clearly states 'self tapping scr', which is an abbreviation for self-tapping screw, and heading 7318 specifically covers 'Screws, bolts, nuts, coach screws, screw hooks, rivets, cotters, cotter-pins, washers (including spring washers) and similar articles, of iron or steel'.
